cohort: Pregnant women admitted to Maharaja Tukojirao Holkar Dedicated COVID Hospital, Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India, between April 17, 2020 and April 30, 2021, divided into two groups: Group A (April 17, 2020, to February 28, 2021) and Group B (March 1, 2021, to April 30, 2021).
finding: The study observed two peaks of SARS-CoV-2 infection in pregnant women, the first with mostly asymptomatic cases and no mortalities, and the second with more severe disease, higher mortality (12 deaths), and more deranged laboratory parameters.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were 56.52% in Group A and 39.06% in Group B; 12.5% of pregnancies ended in abortion; all babies delivered vaginally or via cesarean tested negative for SARS-CoV-2 within 12 hours of delivery.
